gates.question: Is every input to a scored strategy traceable to a named source and digest?
gates.decided_by: Every price row carries a release SHA-256 in data/raw/manifest.json; every outcome row carries the reconciliation record; every availability row carries the capture hash.
gates.consequence: Scored rows may be published with a source class on each row.

gates.question: Was the rule frozen before the evaluation rows were scored?
gates.decided_by: Every strategy carries a content hash of its rule text and a registration version.
gates.consequence: A rule change produces a new hash; the leaderboard shows the hash it scored.

gates.question: Are there silent blanks, duplicate events or imputed values inside a score?
gates.decided_by: Results reconciliation is all-or-nothing, and every blank on the site is rendered as unverified.
gates.consequence: A failure here blocks every score on the page.

gates.question: Does the results feed reproduce the official standings?
gates.decided_by: Wins, losses, ties, points for and points against for all 32 clubs, plus league totals.
gates.consequence: Settlement authority for every graded leg.

gates.question: Does a market have both a pre-kickoff opening and a pre-kickoff close?
gates.decided_by: A closing needs a pre-kickoff number that differs from the opening. The store now holds two captures, and some cells did move, so a genuine opening-to-latest interval exists for those. It is still far too thin for a CLV study: most cells have a single observation.
gates.number: 78 pre-kickoff market cells of 816; 11 snapshot(s); 52 cell(s) moved between captures
gates.consequence: Blocks every closing-line-value claim. Grades on the stored number only.

gates.question: Is there enough settled sample to publish a score at all?
gates.decided_by: Pre-registered floor n>=50 to publish; n>=200 to promote.
gates.number: 149 graded legs on the largest strategy; 149 < 200 for promotion
gates.consequence: Scores are published with intervals. No strategy may be called validated at this n.

gates.question: Is a directly validated joint probability available for combos?
gates.decided_by: No joint outcome series and no validated conditional model exist. Multiplying marginals is invalid under dependence, so S09/S10 stay BLOCKED rather than 'promising'.
gates.consequence: Parlay and prop-combo strategies cannot be scored.

gates.question: Are the operator's void and push rules available?
gates.decided_by: No operator terms are held in this repository; grading uses the mechanical push rule in policy P06.

gates.question: Is every score published with a multiplicity adjustment?
gates.consequence: A p-value is only called significant against this level.

gates.question: Does any live strategy trigger its own kill condition?
gates.decided_by: A strategy whose Brier-skill interval is entirely below zero has failed its kill rule and is demoted to paper status.
gates.number: 3 of 8 scored strategies have an upper bound below zero: S01, S02, S03
gates.consequence: Demoted strategies stay visible, labelled demoted, with their score retained.
